_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Both talk to the RUNNING dev server, so start it
first with `iex-server` (devenv script) -- they will show as disconnected until
tidewave: Dashbit's runtime-intelligence server (Apache-2.0, free). The highest
leverage tool here by a wide margin. project_eval gives the agent an IEx
session inside the live app; get_ash_resources enumerates every Ash domain and
resource; execute_sql_query hits the dev database; get_docs resolves against
the exact versions in mix.lock rather than whatever the model remembers.
Transport is streamable http -- older guides saying `sse` are out of date.
ash_ai_dev: the dev-time MCP server that ash_ai itself mounts. Kept because this
repo is a reference for ash_ai and should demonstrate it, but note that
upstream describes it as experimental and Tidewave covers Ash introspection
better today. Do not rely on it.
The PRODUCTION MCP server is a different thing entirely -- it exposes this
application's Ash actions as tools to external agents over OAuth 2.1, and is
mounted in the router, not here.
